column1: # Response headers for every file a known-vulnerability case serves, as data: knownbug.mjs resolves them per
# staged file into the variant's served.json and its servers send exactly those, so another host (the
# extension, at its own origin) can serve the same cases from the same data.
# A row is case, origin (page | attacker), path pattern (`*`, `*.ext` or an exact served path), header, value.
# `*` matches any case or origin. Rows apply in order, and a later row for the same header replaces an earlier.
